scope: explicit declarations and installed links; not full systemd transaction emulation

file_gates.predicate: nonempty; sleep 4; ExecStartPre subject to service startup timeout
file_gates.producer: Capybara Program.Main -> RunInfoManager.WriteRunInfo, before connectivity init

limits: No generator output, runtime /run overrides or live jobs.
DefaultDependencies, target complement ordering, implicit mount dependencies not simulated.
Template specifiers not expanded; dynamic names are not evidence of missing services.
Application-level waits are documented separately, not treated as systemd unit edges.
